verdict.rationale: LM Studio lets users manage 'prompts, and configurations' (lm-studio-docs-6) and attach MCP tools to models (lm-studio-docs-3/19), which could be used to build task-specific setups, but there is no explicit feature for saving/naming distinct 'assistants' or personas with bundled system prompts, tools, and models. Missing for 10: dedicated assistant/persona creation UI, evidence of saving multiple named assistant profiles, and independent confirmation of this workflow in practice.
